jobs.title: Software Test Engineer (80 – 100%)
jobs.description:
Software Test Engineer (80 – 100%) The CEDES Group offers innovative solutions for elevators, escalators, industrial doors, and warehouse management systems in more than 60 countries. We develop and produce intelligent and safe sensing, control and communication systems that provide actionable data streams for higher operational and maintenance efficiency. Our product portfolio ranges from simple optical sensors to highly complex 3D camera systems and smart IoT-enabling devices. Exploration, collaboration, and reliability are our core values. We are a team of passionate people who love collaborative problem-solving and the open exchange of ideas. We nurture trusting relationships with our partners and customers. Together, we act to anticipate and address future challenges. The Quality & Qualification department is responsible for maintaining high quality standards for our complex products and ensuring compliance with all relevant processes across the Group. Join our team. Your area of responsibility
• Build, test, and qualify software and electronic circuits
• Develop test concepts and test specifications
• Support software development across various platforms
• Conduct software reviews and unit tests within project teams
• Commission and test software on target hardware
• Operate automated tests in laboratory environments
• Prepare measurement reports, test reports, and qualification documentation Our requirements
• Higher education degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Photonics, or Electrical Engineering
• Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies
• Good programming skills in embedded systems using C/C++
• Knowledge of electronics and experience performing tests according to specifications
• Experience in programming processor-based systems
• Quick comprehension and a broad range of technical interests
• Good written and spoken English
• Team-oriented, self-motivated, and goal-driven personality Our offer
• International environment and high-tech, future-oriented products
• Experienced, motivated, interdisciplinary team
• Exciting projects and challenging tasks
• Support in personal development and further education We look forward to receiving your complete application online (-> Apply Now). For data protection reasons, we only accept online applications. CEDES AG, Science Park, CH – 7302 Landquart | +41 81 307 26 43 Apply now

descriptionByLocale.it:
Software Test Engineer (80 – 100%) Il Gruppo CEDES offre soluzioni innovative per ascensori, scale mobili, porte industriali e sistemi di gestione del magazzino in oltre 60 paesi. Sviluppiamo e produciamo sistemi di rilevamento, controllo e comunicazione intelligenti e sicuri che forniscono flussi di dati attuabili per una maggiore efficienza operativa e di manutenzione. Il nostro portafoglio prodotti spazia dai semplici sensori ottici ai sistemi di telecamere 3D altamente complessi e ai dispositivi intelligenti IoT-abilitazione. Esplorazione, collaborazione e affidabilità sono i nostri valori fondamentali. Siamo un team di appassionati che amano la risoluzione dei problemi collaborativi e lo scambio aperto di idee. Nutriamo relazioni di fiducia con i nostri partner e clienti. Insieme, agiamo per anticipare e affrontare le sfide future. Il reparto Qualità & Qualifica è responsabile del mantenimento di elevati standard di qualità per i nostri prodotti complessi e del rispetto di tutti i processi rilevanti in tutto il Gruppo. Unisciti alla nostra squadra. La vostra area di responsabilità
• Costruire, testare e qualificare i circuiti software e elettronici
• Sviluppare concetti di test e specifiche di test
• Supporta lo sviluppo del software su varie piattaforme
• Condurre recensioni software e test unitari nei team di progetto
• Commissione e software di prova sull'hardware di destinazione
• Operare test automatizzati in ambienti di laboratorio
• Preparare report di misurazione, report di prova e documentazione di qualificazione
• Laurea in ingegneria del software, informatica, fotonica o ingegneria elettrica
• Forte conoscenza delle metodologie di test software
• Buone competenze di programmazione nei sistemi incorporati utilizzando C/C++
• Conoscenza dell'elettronica e delle prove di esperienza secondo le specifiche
• Esperienza nei sistemi basati su processori di programmazione
• Rapida comprensione e una vasta gamma di interessi tecnici
• Buono scritto e parlato inglese
• Personalità orientata al team, automotivata e orientata agli obiettivi
• Ambiente internazionale e prodotti ad alta tecnologia, orientati al futuro
• Team esperto, motivato, interdisciplinare
• Progetti eccitanti e compiti impegnativi
• Sostegno allo sviluppo personale e all'ulteriore formazione Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere l'applicazione completa online (-> Applicare Ora). Per motivi di protezione dei dati, accettiamo solo applicazioni online. CEDES AG, Science Park, CH – 7302 Landquart | +41 81 307 26 43

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ingénieur de test logiciel (80 – 100%) Le Groupe CEDES propose des solutions innovantes pour les ascenseurs, les escaliers mécaniques, les portes industrielles et les systèmes de gestion des entrepôts dans plus de 60 pays. Nous développons et produisons des systèmes intelligents et sûrs de détection, de contrôle et de communication qui fournissent des flux de données actionnables pour une plus grande efficacité opérationnelle et de maintenance. Notre gamme de produits va de simples capteurs optiques à des systèmes de caméras 3D très complexes et des appareils intelligents IoT. L'exploration, la collaboration et la fiabilité sont nos valeurs fondamentales. Nous sommes une équipe de personnes passionnées qui aiment la résolution de problèmes en collaboration et l'échange ouvert d'idées. Nous entretenons des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires et nos clients. Ensemble, nous agissons pour anticiper et relever les défis futurs. Le département Qualité & Qualification est chargé de maintenir des normes de qualité élevées pour nos produits complexes et d'assurer la conformité à tous les processus pertinents dans l'ensemble du Groupe. Rejoignez notre équipe. Votre domaine de responsabilité
• Construire, tester et qualifier les circuits logiciels et électroniques
• Élaborer des concepts d'essai et des spécifications d'essai
• Soutenir le développement de logiciels sur différentes plateformes
• Effectuer des examens de logiciels et des tests unitaires au sein des équipes de projet
• Commission et logiciel de test sur le matériel cible
• Effectuer des tests automatisés en laboratoire
• Préparer des rapports de mesure, des rapports de test et des documents de qualification Nos exigences
• Diplôme d'études supérieures en génie logiciel, informatique, photonique ou génie électrique
• Connaissance approfondie des méthodes d'essai des logiciels
• Bonnes compétences en programmation dans les systèmes embarqués utilisant C/C++
• Connaissance de l'électronique et expérience en matière d'essais selon les spécifications
• Expérience des systèmes de programmation basés sur les processeurs
• Une compréhension rapide et un large éventail d'intérêts techniques
• Bon anglais écrit et parlé
• Personnalité axée sur l'équipe, automotivée et axée sur les buts Notre offre
• Environnement international et produits de haute technologie orientés vers l'avenir
• Équipe interdisciplinaire, motivée et expérimentée
• Projets passionnants et tâches difficiles
• Soutien au développement personnel et à la formation continue Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre candidature complète en ligne (-> Postuler maintenant). Pour des raisons de protection des données, nous n'acceptons que des applications en ligne. CEDES AG, Parc des sciences, CH – 7302 Landquart

jobs.title: Packaging Line Worker (100%)
jobs.description:
Packaging Line Worker (100%) temporary position for about 4 months The CEDES Group offers its innovative solutions for elevators, escalators, industrial doors, and warehouse management systems in more than 60 countries. We develop and produce intelligent and safe sensing, control and communication systems that provide actionable data streams for higher operational and maintenance efficiency. Our product portfolio ranges from simple optical sensors to highly complex 3D camera systems and smart IoT-enabling devices. Exploration, collaboration, and reliability are our core values. We are a team of passionate people who love collaborative problem-solving and the open exchange of ideas. We nurture trusting relationships with our partners and customers. Together, we act to anticipate and address future challenges. Our MTO (Make To Order) department is responsible for the proper packaging of end products and preparing batches for shipment. Join our team. Your area of responsibility
• Proper packaging of products with regard to quality, quantity and time
• Work on the packaging line
• Preparatory work using handheld scanners
• Update system bookings from preceding and subsequent departments
• Support with rolling inventory
• Nurturing respectful team interactions
• Keeping the workplace and the department clean Our requirements
• Experience in using scanners / ERP systems (pick/pack)
• Good physical fitness
• Organized, diligent and swift way of working
• Manual skills and quick grasp
• Reliable team player with a good sense of humor
• Good knowledge of German Our offer
• International environment and high-tech, future-oriented products
• Experienced, motivated, interdisciplinary team
• Exciting projects and challenging tasks
• Support in personal development and further education
• 5 weeks holidays, 3 bridging days, as well as flexible working times and models
• Modern workplace with a restaurant and a Starbucks corner We look forward to receiving your complete application online (-> Apply Now). For data protection reasons, we only accept online applications. CEDES AG, Science Park, CH – 7302 Landquart | +41 81 307 26 43 Apply now
